items.standfirst: Memphis Grizzlies forward Brandon Clarke's death was due to the effects of heroin and cocaine, the Los Angeles medical authority reveals.

items.title: NBA player Brandon Clarke died from effects of heroin and cocaine, officials say
items.standfirst: Memphis Grizzlies forward Brandon Clarke died in May from the effects of heroin and cocaine, authorities said Friday.
